title: Your Inner Critic
description: Find out whose voice is dictating the negative thoughts in your head when you make a mistake.

questions.ic_1: If I'm not productive all day, the voice in my head tells me I'm useless.
questions.ic_2: I often blame myself excessively for small mistakes from the past.
questions.ic_3: When someone replies to my message briefly, I'm immediately sure they're angry with me.
questions.ic_4: I feel there's no room to rest until all my work is done perfectly.
questions.ic_5: The voice in my head often reminds me how selfish or troublesome I am.
questions.ic_6: I often replay social interactions, afraid I said something that made people secretly hate me.
questions.ic_7: The word 'should' (I should be better, I should be smarter) keeps dominating my thoughts.
questions.ic_8: I feel I deserve to be punished or to have bad things happen when things don't go well.
questions.ic_9: I hold back from speaking in meetings or class because I'm sure others will think my idea is stupid.
questions.ic_10: Getting a B or a small reprimand feels like a total, humiliating failure.
questions.ic_11: I feel fully responsible for my parents' or partner's happiness.
questions.ic_12: When my boss or teacher calls me in, my first thought is: 'Someone must have reported something bad about me.'
questions.ic_13: It's hard for me to celebrate success because the voice in my head says 'This isn't good enough yet.'
questions.ic_14: I feel the good luck I get will someday be taken away because I don't deserve it.
questions.ic_15: When friends compliment me, I often think they're just lying to be polite.
questions.ic_16: I measure my self-worth only by how much I got done today.
questions.ic_17: When I turn down someone's request, guilt haunts me for days.
questions.ic_18: Being in public makes me tense because I feel everyone is judging how I look.
questions.ic_19: If I'm sick and have to rest, I get stressed about wasting time.
questions.ic_20: I feel that asking for help is the same as showing I'm weak and a burden.
questions.ic_21: I often change my personal opinions to match the majority so I won't be judged.
questions.ic_22: I often compare how fast I'm succeeding with other people my age.
questions.ic_23: I feel I'm not allowed to be happy when someone close to me is going through a hard time.
questions.ic_24: My biggest fear is being seen as 'weird' or 'incompetent' by the people around me.

results.description: Your critic demands absolute perfection. You feel your worth is decided by achievement and productivity.
Your critic likes to make you feel guilty about the past or convince you that you're a burden to others.
Your critic always guesses the worst about what others think of you (fear of being judged).
